notes: Sending a song to an album now lists the albums you actually made, in the order the Albums page keeps them, with how many songs each one holds - instead of names picked up from the tags on your files.

No more made-up album names in that list: a tag is not an album, so a single, a compilation or a junk label can no longer appear there, and a song you send this way joins its album on the Albums page.
The version number counts the way it always has: one digit after the first dot, so 80.9 is followed by 81, then 81.1 and 81.2 - 80.10 and 80.11 are gone from the history.
